hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/kissimmee-prairie-preserve-state-park/experiences-amenities ('Water and electricity are provided at all 35 campsites') + Reserve Florida unit details for Loop FAM (all 17 listed units Electric Hookup 30; Water Hookup on 16), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Kilpatrick Hammock family campground: 35 water/electric sites, vehicle lengths 20 to 65 ft by site. Reserve Florida lists 17 bookable family-loop units (one tent-only), all back-in but one pull-through. The 13 equestrian sites (50-amp, with paddocks) are a separate loop, and three hike/bike-in primitive sites and safari glamping tents are also offered.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/kissimmee-prairie-preserve-state-park/experiences-amenities ('Be sure to check the description of each site for maximum vehicle length as sites can vary from 20 feet – 65 feet', 'Maximum recreational vehicle length is 65 feet', '13 available sites' in the equestrian campground) + Reserve Florida search/details for facility 88 (VehicleLength 25-65, PullInTypeName), read 2026-10-21
